tasks.title: Ship the DeployStepProtocol + DeploymentContextBundle type contracts (sc1/sc2)
tasks.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/types.ts carrying the flat a1 envelope field-for-field: DeployPhase union, DeployStepRequest, DeployStepResponse, DeployStageRegistrar (sc1) plus the DeploymentEntityRef/DeploymentRelationRef/DeploymentCitation/DeploymentContextBundle quartet (sc2). Joins the analyze-step/build-step/workflow-step envelope family; PascalCase types in a kebab-case file, kept independent of AnalyzeContextBundle's internal layers. This is the root contract every other piece and all of s2–s6 consume verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/deploy-step/types.ts exports DeployPhase as exactly 'start'|'discover'|'reuse'|'topology'|'security'|'scale'|'done'.

Exports DeployStepRequest{phase;repo?;state?;focus?;payload?}, DeployStepResponse{next;guidance;prompt?;schema?;state;markdown?}, and DeployStageRegistrar{stage;register():void} field-for-field per the sc1 interfaceSketch (flat, no per-phase discriminated union).

Exports DeploymentEntityRef, DeploymentRelationRef, DeploymentCitation (entityId optional), and DeploymentContextBundle{stage;summary;entities[];relations[];citations[]} per the sc2 sketch, with no structural dependency on AnalyzeContextBundle.
Compiles under strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes with every optional property typed as `| undefined`, and imports use `.js` extensions / `import type`.

tasks.title: Add the private deploy-step run state + state-store
tasks.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/state.ts (DeployStepStage) and src/mcp/deploy-step/state-store.ts (private per-run record behind the opaque state token, plus _clearDeployStateStoreForTests), mirroring workflow-step/state.ts + state-store.ts. State lives only in-process — never persisted to LMDB/Lance/DuckDB — preserving the k4 single-owner-of-storage rule and the S001 durability non-functional.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/deploy-step/state.ts exports DeployStepStage keyed off DeployPhase; src/mcp/deploy-step/state-store.ts holds a private run record keyed by the opaque state token.
state-store.ts exports _clearDeployStateStoreForTests() that resets the in-memory store, and imports no LMDB/Lance/DuckDB module.
Minting a run returns a token that round-trips to its record; an unknown/fabricated token resolves to no record; a record is discardable after next==='done'.
Files compile under strict mode; logging (if any) uses getLogger('deploy-<stage>')-style loggers, never console.log.

tasks.title: Implement the additive deploy-rpc daemon seam
tasks.summary: Create src/daemon/deploy-rpc.ts and register one new deploy method into the daemon/index.ts handler registry, patterned on analyze-rpc.ts/workflow-rpc.ts. This is the seam through which deploy-step sources graph context (k4) without any runner opening a DB directly. The k3 lock-step invariant requires it add only new method names and mutate no existing registration, socket path, or payload shape.
acceptanceChecks: src/daemon/deploy-rpc.ts exists and registers a new deploy RPC method into the daemon/index.ts registry via a single additive registration, patterned on analyze-rpc.ts/workflow-rpc.ts.
The existing socket path (~/.insrc/daemon.sock), pre-existing IPC method names, and existing payload shapes are unchanged (additive-only; no existing registration mutated).
The seam returns DeploymentContextBundle-shaped, graph-grounded data and never opens LMDB/Lance/DuckDB from outside the daemon-owned graph access.
Repo resolution surfaces UnregisteredRepoError (naming the unresolved path, pointing at repo.add) when the resolved repo is not registered/indexed.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/deploy-rpc.test.ts › registers the additive deploy method only, leaving the pre-existing daemon RPC method set / socket path / payload shapes untouched, and surfaces UnregisteredRepoError for an unregistered resolved repo

tasks.title: Implement handleDeployStep dispatcher with full error-path handling
tasks.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/handler.ts exporting handleDeployStep(req): Promise<DeployStepResponse> — the deploy-step analogue of handleWorkflowStep. It resolves repo, looks up/advances the state-store record, dispatches req.phase to the registered DeployStageRegistrar, and covers every errorPaths case: unregistered repo, unknown/unregistered phase, unknown/expired state token, out-of-order phase, ajv schema-validation failure, mid-loop stage/provider failure, and the completed-run replay edge case. All provider/narrow calls run serial for...of — never Promise.all.
acceptanceChecks: handleDeployStep dispatches each DeployPhase to its registered DeployStageRegistrar and returns a DeployStepResponse whose next/guidance/prompt/schema/state advance or terminate the loop, echoing state verbatim.
A phase with no registered stage (out-of-union string or un-register()'d valid phase) returns a terminal error listing dispatchable DeployPhase values without advancing next.

Unknown/expired state tokens are rejected with restart-from-start guidance (never minting a fresh run under a stale token); out-of-order phase is rejected reporting the expected next stage and leaves the run record unmutated.
Emitted payloads are validated with ajv against the issued schema; on failure the same prompt+schema are re-issued with field errors and the record is not advanced.

A stage/provider failure returns a stage-scoped error preserving the state token for retry (no partial bundle); all narrow/LLM invocation is serial for...of with no Promise.all over a provider, and the repo path raises UnregisteredRepoError when unregistered.

A follow-up call carrying a still-live state token for a run whose prior response was next==='done' idempotently re-returns that run's already-rendered markdown (or an explicit already-complete signal) without re-dispatching any stage, and only degrades to the unknown/expired-token error once the record has been discarded.

tests.name: src/mcp/deploy-step/__tests__/deploy-step-handler.test.ts › handleDeployStep dispatches each DeployPhase over its registered DeployStageRegistrar, advances/echoes next+guidance+prompt+schema+state verbatim, and drives all narrow invocation serially with no Promise.all over a provider

src/mcp/deploy-step/__tests__/deploy-step-handler.test.ts › error paths — unregistered-phase returns a terminal error listing dispatchable DeployPhase values, unregistered repo raises UnregisteredRepoError pointing at repo.add, out-of-order phase reports the expected next stage and leaves the record unmutated, ajv failure re-issues the same prompt+schema, and a completed-run replay idempotently re-returns markdown

Per-stage runner bodies (discover/reuse/topology/security/scale) are deferred to s2–s6; s1 proves the loop skeleton and the emit_bundle → DeploymentContextBundle output contract on the representative path only.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/deploy-step/phases/ contains a representative phase handler that returns prompt + JSON schema for its emit step and, on emit_bundle, produces a well-formed DeploymentContextBundle quartet (never a raw file dump).
The representative handler registers itself into the dispatch table through a DeployStageRegistrar.register() implementation so handleDeployStep can route its phase.

An empty deployment surface yields a well-formed bundle with empty entities/relations/citations and an explanatory summary (valid result, not an error); a large entity set stays a structured quartet and is never downgraded to a raw dump.
Bundle entity/citation paths are graph-sourced DeploymentEntityRef values (SHA256 entityId, non-hallucinated path), not free-text file references.

tasks.title: Wire the src/deploy/ chain.ts + runner scaffold (register<Stage> registrar seam)
tasks.summary: Create src/deploy/chain.ts plus a runner-scaffold index.ts + schemas.ts pair, mirroring the src/workflow/runners/<name>/ + src/workflow/chain.ts idiom. chain.ts drives the stage order discover → reuse → topology → {security, scale-HA} → done through handleDeployStep and exposes the register<Stage>Runners() registrar seam (DeployStageRegistrar) that s2–s6 plug stages into without touching chain internals. Because the real s2–s6 stage bodies do not exist yet, s1 proves the ordering over stubbed stage runners emitting deterministic DeploymentContextBundles, per the LLD testStrategy. The security/scale fan-out runs as serial DeployPhase transitions.
acceptanceChecks: src/deploy/chain.ts drives stage order discover → reuse → topology → {security, scale} → done via handleDeployStep, proven in s1 over stubbed stage runners emitting deterministic DeploymentContextBundles, with the security/scale fan-out executed as serial DeployPhase transitions (never Promise.all over a provider).
A runner index.ts exposes a register<Stage>Runners(): void registrar (camelCase) that binds a DeployStageRegistrar into the deploy-step dispatch table, with a paired schemas.ts contract file.

chain-order internals (wiring order, RPC dispatch, state serialization) are private to s1 — downstream stages see only the DeployStepProtocol envelope and DeploymentContextBundle, never the chain internals.
File names follow the sibling idiom (chain.ts / index.ts / schemas.ts) and functions are camelCase per the convention-detect finding.

src/deploy/__tests__/chain.test.ts › stubbed src/deploy/ stage runners bound through register<Stage>Runners() emit deterministic DeploymentContextBundle quartets, keeping bundle assembly asserted without a live daemon graph

tasks.title: Register the deploy-step MCP tool into src/mcp/server.ts
tasks.summary: Wire the deploy-step loop into src/mcp/server.ts so handleDeployStep is exposed as an MCP tool alongside the existing workflow-step/analyze-step/build-step servers, using the shared phase/state transport. This is the private s1-owned server transport that closes the end-to-end path from an MCP caller through the chain (t6) to the daemon deploy-rpc seam. The full start→done proof runs over t6's stubbed stage runners, since the real s2–s6 stage bodies land later.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/server.ts registers the deploy-step tool driving handleDeployStep, joining the workflow-step/analyze-step/build-step sibling servers over the shared phase/state transport.
The registration is additive — it introduces the new deploy-step tool without altering existing MCP tool registrations.

A full start → discover → reuse → topology → {security, scale} → done loop, sequenced by t6's chain.ts over stubbed stage runners (deterministic DeploymentContextBundles), is dispatchable through the server and returns populated markdown on the done terminal, echoing the opaque state token verbatim each call.
repo defaults to $INSRC_REPO when omitted, matching the analyze-step fallback, and an unregistered fallback surfaces UnregisteredRepoError.
